label: Texas: enforcement and cure opportunity
note: Editorial summary of the cited current primary law, not a verbatim statutory extract. Cure/enforcement checkpoint: September 22, 2026. Independent content review and practitioner review are separate. This card addresses the comprehensive privacy law's cure opportunity and enforcement actor, not a complete remedies schedule.
body: The Attorney General has exclusive enforcement authority. Section 541.154 requires written notice identifying the alleged provisions at least thirty days before a §541.155 action.

The Attorney General may not bring the action if the person cures within that period and gives a written statement confirming cure, consumer notification when the consumer's contact information has been made available to the person, supportive documentation, and internal-policy changes when necessary to prevent such further violations.
Continued violations after cure or breach of the written statement can support enforcement. No cure sunset is stated.
